advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Make `_pending_reconciled`'s level-check and marker clear atomic w.r.t. concurrent writers so a fresh marker recorded between the check and the clear is not destroyed (freshness.py:153-157).
evidence: Shared mutable resource: the `rebar-push-pending` marker file in the tracker's git dir — push_state.py:59 `MARKER = "rebar-push-pending"`, push_state.py:90-91 `_marker_path` -> `StorePaths(tracker).git_dir`; docs/concurrency.md:581-582 'recorded as durable state ... written by rebar._store.push_state'.

≥2 concurrent executors: (a) a gate reader running `store_freshness` -> `_pending_reconciled`; (b) a detached async push CHILD spawned at src/rebar/_store/push.py:200-206 `spawn_detached("rebar._store.push", "push_tickets_branch", ... stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)`, which records the marker after the parent returns — docs/concurrency.md:599-601 'the marker is written by the detached CHILD, so a failure can land after the parent's call returns'; docs/concurrency.md:610-612 'this host runs many worktrees against one shared tickets branch'.

Interleaving window — READ: `if remote_ref is None or not _head_is_level_with(tracker, remote_ref): return False` (freshness.py:153, git-state equality read). WRITE that races it: `push_state.record_failure(...)` -> `fsutil.atomic_write(_marker_path(tracker), ...)` (push_state.py:182) writing a fresh marker while HEAD advances, followed by the reader's `push_state.clear(tracker)  # never raises` (freshness.py:157) -> `os.remove(_marker_path(tracker))` (push_state.py:194) deleting it.

Sibling guard the new clear copies in SHAPE but not atomicity: completion_delivery.py:297-301 clears only `if local_oid == remote_oid:` '# ... a different local HEAD can belong to a concurrent writer whose delivery outcome we do not own'. The new code's own docstring cites this (freshness.py:147-151) yet performs the equality check and the clear as two separate statements, so it detects the safe condition and then acts outside it (disposition-aware: a guard that detects then proceeds is itself the finding).

Concrete harm: lost update / destroyed invariant — a fresh valid push-pending marker for genuinely-undelivered commits is deleted, so a subsequent gate reads state=='ok' (push_state.py:219-220) and store_freshness returns fresh (freshness.py:223 `return result`), causing the gate to mint/withhold an operation certificate against a stale store — the exact cibophobic-moist-guineafowl / b928-3ab6-5985-417b corruption the marker exists to prevent (docs/concurrency.md:617-621; tests/unit/test_gate_store_freshness.py:1-7).
advisory.finding: `_pending_reconciled` clears the durable push-pending marker on a non-atomic check-then-act: it reads HEAD-vs-remote_ref equality (`_head_is_level_with`, freshness.py:153) and then unconditionally `push_state.clear(tracker)` (freshness.py:157). A concurrent same-clone writer can, in that window, commit a new ticket event and have its failed push record a fresh, valid push-pending marker; the clear then deletes that fresh marker, so a later gate reads state=='ok' and certifies against a store that genuinely holds undelivered events.
scenarios: Two worktrees on one host share the tickets branch: worktree A's gate runs store_freshness while worktree B (or A's own detached async push child) commits a new event and records a fresh push-pending marker between A's level-check and its clear.
An async-policy push child records the marker just after a gate has read HEAD as level but before the gate's os.remove fires.
advisory.suggested_fix: Capture the marker identity/oid that justified the clear and clear only that exact marker: read the marker's recorded `remote_ref`/`unpushed`/`since` (or the HEAD oid) before the level-check, and in `push_state.clear` only remove the marker if it is byte-identical to the one observed (a compare-and-delete), so a fresher marker recorded in the window survives. Alternatively gate the check+clear under the same store write lock the writer uses.

coaching.coaching: File a follow-on ticket (discovered_from this change) for non-atomic check-then-act in _pending_reconciled, a pre-existing / out-of-scope issue — do not fix it in this change.
